steps.thought: I have the schemas for all three files. I will now construct a DuckDB SQL query to join these files and retrieve the superpowers of '3-D Man'. I need to be careful with the JSON file and use `unnest(records)` as per the rules.

action_input.sql:
SELECT
  sp.power_name
FROM
  (SELECT unnest(records) AS r FROM read_json_auto('json/superhero.json')) AS sh
JOIN
  'csv/hero_power.csv' AS hp
ON
  sh.r.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN
  'csv/superpower.csv' AS sp
ON
  hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE
  sh.r.superhero_name = '3-D Man';
